policy: Falsified, superseded and mechanism-only specifications are removed from the active shadow evaluator by default. Their immutable rows remain queryable. Re-enabling telemetry requires the explicit BORG_INCLUDE_PARKED_CONTROLS override; redesign requires a new strategy id and evidence boundary.

dispositions.reason: The frozen manifest required stopping if mean 2x-cost PnL was non-positive after 100 independent 15-minute markets. The arm exceeded that count and remained negative, so its pre-registered early-kill rule fired.

More than 1,300 fresh markets produced materially negative doubled-cost PnL with both chronological halves negative. The accidental H52 discovery profit did not replicate; live execution remains disabled.

The fresh unchanged forward arm reversed the discovery point estimate and was materially negative over its first 73 independent markets. It is parked as a non-promotable control; any redesign needs a new id.
